scope: Controlled ECDM fault-injection experiment only; thresholds are experiment-specific operating limits and are not universal production thresholds.

cpu.rationale: Moderate CPU pressure is observed without intervention; sustained high CPU pressure triggers capacity-oriented recovery.

memory.rationale: Lower synthetic memory pressure is treated conservatively; pressure at or above the experimental threshold triggers service restart semantics.

latency.rationale: Moderate transient delay is observed; higher injected delay triggers rollback to the stable configuration.

errors.rationale: Low synthetic error probability is observed; error probability at or above the experimental threshold triggers rollback.

dependency.rationale: A confirmed unavailable dependency is mapped to dependency-specific recovery.
